en.neighbours_title: Life at Lampton Parkside, from residents
en.auto_p2: Every home is finished to Hill’s specification as standard, with integrated kitchen appliances, flooring throughout and underfloor heating included in the price you agree.
en.nexus_h: A new landmark address in Stevenage, 22 minutes from King’s Cross
en.nexus_p1: Nexus brings 118 one, two and three bedroom apartments to the centre of Stevenage, arranged as two buildings around a landscaped garden square. Every home is finished to Hill’s five-star standard, with a private balcony or terrace and residents’ parking.
en.north-gate-park_h: New apartments and houses in Harringay, North London
en.north-gate-park_p1: North Gate Park brings a collection of 1 & 2 bedroom apartments to Harringay, set around a central landscaped garden with ecological planting inspired by North London’s green heritage.
en.north-gate-park_p2: Chestnuts Park sits moments away, Harringay Train Station just 12 mins walk and Harringay Green Lanes Overground Station is just a 13-minute walk away.
en.nexus_p2: Stevenage station sits a five minute walk away, putting King’s Cross within 25 minutes and Cambridge within half an hour — the reason Nexus consistently achieves rental yields of up to 6.6% (Putterills Estate Agent, predicted yields for 2027).
en.fitzwilliam-gate_p2: Every home comes with Hill’s premium all-inclusive specification as standard, with integrated kitchen appliances and flooring throughout included in the agreed price.
en.cambium-square_h: A brand new development in Cambourne
en.cambium-square_p1: Cambium Square is a new collection of contemporary homes set within green surroundings, just eight miles from Cambridge.
en.cambium-square_p2: With spacious interiors, excellent local schools and everyday amenities within walking distance, it offers modern family living with easy access to Cambridge’s world-renowned employment and innovation hubs.
en.city-reach_p1: City Reach offers stylish 1 & 2 bedroom apartments close to Cambridge city centre and within walking distance of Cambridge Station.
en.city-reach_p2: With green open space on the doorstep and Cambridge’s world-renowned universities, employment and innovation hubs within easy reach, it’s perfectly placed for modern city living.
en.marleigh-park_h: Space to live, grow and belong
en.marleigh-park_p1: Marleigh Park is a vibrant new neighbourhood offering beautifully designed homes surrounded by green open spaces, just three miles from central Cambridge.
en.marleigh-park_p2: With its own shops, community facilities and places to meet and unwind, Marleigh Park offers a more relaxed way of life while keeping Cambridge’s city centre, schools and major employment hubs within easy reach.
en.southville-collection_p1: The Southville Collection sits within the heart of BS3, one of Bristol’s most sought-after residential postcodes. Combining a strong community feel with city convenience, the area offers a lifestyle that blends independent culture, green space, and excellent connectivity.
en.southville-collection_p2: From North Street’s vibrant café culture to the open landscapes of Ashton Court Estate, this area continues to attract professionals, families and first-time buyers looking for new homes in Southville, Bristol, combining lifestyle, connectivity and long-term value.
en.barnet_h: Thoughtfully designed homes in an exceptional location
en.barnet_p1: An exclusive collection of beautifully designed 1 and 2 bedroom apartments and 3, 4 and 5 bedroom houses is coming soon to Barnet. Set within one of North London’s most desirable family locations, this exceptional new development combines contemporary architecture, thoughtfully crafted interiors and excellent connectivity to create sophisticated homes designed for modern living.
en.little-chalfont-park_p1: Little Chalfont Park is a new neighbourhood with up to 380 homes (40% affordable), 100 retirement homes, a 60-room care home, a mixed-use local centre, and land reserved for education. Over half the site will remain open landscape, including play and wildlife areas, while existing woodland and parkland will be enhanced and a new Valley Park created.
en.little-chalfont-park_p2: Designed to promote healthy, sustainable living, the development will provide walking and cycling links to Little Chalfont village centre and station. Alongside much-needed new housing, it will deliver new amenities for both existing and future residents.

tr.nexus_h: Stevenage’da yeni bir adres, King’s Cross’a 22 dakika
tr.nexus_p1: Nexus, Stevenage merkezine bir, iki ve üç yatak odalı 118 daire kazandırıyor; peyzajlı bir bahçe meydanı çevresinde iki bina olarak düzenlendi. Her konut Hill’in beş yıldızlı standardında, özel balkon veya teras ve sakin otoparkıyla teslim ediliyor.

ar.nexus_h: عنوان جديد في ستيفنيج، على 22 دقيقة من King’s Cross
ar.nexus_p1: يقدم Nexus 118 شقة من غرفة واحدة وغرفتين وثلاث غرف في قلب ستيفنيج، موزعة على مبنيين حول ساحة حديقة منسقة. كل منزل مُنفّذ بمعيار Hill الخمس نجوم، مع شرفة خاصة وموقف للسكان.
ar.nexus_p2: تبعد محطة ستيفنيج ثماني دقائق سيرًا، مما يجعل King’s Cross على 22 دقيقة وكامبردج على نصف ساعة — وهو سبب بلوغ عوائد الإيجار حتى 6.6%.

yue.nexus_h: Stevenage全新地標住址，距離King's Cross僅22分鐘
yue.nexus_p1: Nexus為Stevenage市中心帶來118個1房、2房及3房單位，分佈於兩座大樓，環繞園景花園廣場而建。每個住宅均以Hill五星級標準完成裝修，設私家露台或平台及住戶車位。
yue.north-gate-park_h: 倫敦北部Harringay全新單位及獨立屋
yue.north-gate-park_p1: North Gate Park為Harringay帶來一系列1房及2房單位，環繞中央園景花園而建，花園植栽設計取材自倫敦北部的綠化傳統。
yue.north-gate-park_p2: Chestnuts Park近在咫尺，步行12分鐘可達Harringay Train Station，步行13分鐘可達Harringay Green Lanes Overground Station。
yue.nexus_p2: Stevenage站步行僅5分鐘可達，25分鐘可達King's Cross，半小時可達劍橋 — 這正是Nexus租金回報率長期高達6.6%的原因（Putterills地產代理，2027年預測回報率）。
yue.fitzwilliam-gate_p2: 每個住宅均配備Hill尊尚全包裝修規格，嵌入式廚房電器及全屋地板已包含於議定價格內。
yue.cambium-square_p1: Cambium Square是一系列全新現代住宅，坐擁綠意環境，距離劍橋僅8英里。
yue.cambium-square_p2: 室內空間寬敞，優質當地學校及日常生活設施均在步行可達範圍內，提供現代家庭生活體驗，同時輕鬆直達劍橋舉世知名的就業及創新樞紐。
yue.city-reach_p1: City Reach提供時尚1房及2房單位，鄰近劍橋市中心，步行可達Cambridge Station。
yue.city-reach_p2: 綠化開放空間近在家門，劍橋舉世知名的大學、就業及創新樞紐亦輕鬆直達，完美配合現代城市生活所需。
yue.marleigh-park_p1: Marleigh Park是一個充滿活力的全新社區，提供設計精美的住宅，四周綠化開放空間環繞，距離劍橋市中心僅3英里。
yue.marleigh-park_p2: Marleigh Park設有自家商舖、社區設施及聚會休閒場所，提供更悠閒的生活方式，同時輕鬆直達劍橋市中心、學校及主要就業樞紐。
yue.southville-collection_p1: The Southville Collection坐落於BS3核心地段，是布里斯托最搶手的住宅郵區之一。此地段融合濃厚社區氛圍與城市便利，生活方式糅合獨立文化、綠化空間及優越交通網絡。
yue.southville-collection_p2: 由North Street充滿活力的咖啡文化，到Ashton Court Estate的開闊景致，此地區持續吸引專業人士、家庭及首次置業人士，尋找布里斯托Southville的全新住宅，糅合生活品味、交通便利及長遠價值。
yue.barnet_h: 優越地段，用心設計的住宅
yue.barnet_p1: 一系列獨家設計精美的1房及2房單位，以及3房、4房及5房獨立屋，即將於Barnet推出。此卓越新盤坐落於倫敦北部其中一個最理想的家庭地段，糅合現代建築設計、用心打造的室內空間及優越交通網絡，呈獻為現代生活而設的高雅住宅。
yue.little-chalfont-park_p1: Little Chalfont Park是一個全新社區，提供最多380個住宅單位（當中40%為可負擔住宅）、100個退休住宅、1間60房護理院、1個綜合用途社區中心，以及預留教育用地。逾半地段將保留為開放景觀，包括遊樂及野生動物保育區域，現有林地及公園將予以優化，並將新建Valley Park。
yue.little-chalfont-park_p2: 此新盤旨在推動健康、可持續的生活方式，將提供步行及單車連接前往Little Chalfont村中心及車站。除了提供急需的全新住宅外，亦將為現有及未來居民帶來全新生活設施。
